description: This file defines error handling structures for API responses, including backend error codes, an error details class, and an exception class for use in a Flutter/Dart project.

classes.name: BackendErrorCode
classes.description: An enumeration of specific backend error codes used to tailor UI/UX responses.

classes.name: ApiErrorDetails
classes.description: A class representing detailed information about an API error, including code, message, status, and additional metadata.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: A class for wrapping API error details into an exception that can be thrown and caught in application logic.

methods.name: _codeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a BackendErrorCode enum value.

methods.name: _intFrom
methods.description: Converts various data types to an int, used for parsing numeric values from JSON.

methods.name: fromHttpBody
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response body and status code to produce an ApiErrorDetails instance.
